entries.5e335b287923a137: The company manufactures and sells compound feed for fish farming, Nagaya Suisan Co., Ltd. sells fresh seafood and compound feed for fish farming, and Amami Kurumaebi Co., Ltd. cultivates and sells kuruma prawns. The business consists of manufacturing and sales of feed for fish farming such as kuruma prawns and yellowtail, sales of farmed fish such as sea bream and yellowtail, and cultivation of kuruma prawns. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥7,740 million.
